episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a Casual Friday broadcast from the BIN newsroom, applying a comically oversized temporary Matt tattoo to his arm before welcoming Jeff Ripple — also tattooed — for a news block covering Trump's Iran rhetoric, a Japanese idol's armpit-sniffing fan service, a Pokemon card heist at Best Buy, Montreal pothole vigilantes, South Africa's AI-written AI policy, and an Armenian zebra-or-donkey mystery. The centerpiece is a full reading of Palantir's 22-point manifesto framing AI as the new nuclear deterrent and demanding universal conscription. The show closes with a malfunctioning AI Rooney segment — its metal frame shedding skin — processing chat complaints that veer into ferret/hip-joint fetish territory, interrupted by Kendelle's arrival and her own rapid Matt tattoo application.
